description: Corpus cases whose mid-surface is graded good or perfect with the chain of this tree: gmshMat --raw tet --filter collapse, fusion with the shipped face-pairing walls (fuse.py --gentle --part), evaluator projected_quality.measure(.., 4000, 'surface', True).

measured.mesh: surface mesh of size thickness/10, generated once per case and shared with the Python prototype of the same MAT
measured.replay: 2026-11-26, same machine: run_corpus.py, which meshes the skin from the STEP file, returns the same scores to the last digit on the 71 cases

units: missing_area and off_truth_area in thickness^2, worst_distance in thickness
